# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P39](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril possesses endearing good looks, featuring magnificent dark, velvety eyes. He wears a Scarlet and White badge attached to his coat lapel as a student at Wexcombe.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Polite, respectful, and romantic, Cyril expresses his affection through poetic praises and sonnets. He carries himself as a somber, mysterious hero, though he lacks a sense of humor and is considered by some to lack true substance or interest. Despite his charm, he can display overly confident behavior and enjoys teasing animals.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014), [v3 c38 P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## History

Cyril belonged to the elite Gardner family in Portmaris. After his father's death and his mother's health broke down, he was forced to interrupt his university studies and travel overseas with her for two years. Upon returning, he resumed his studies as a Junior at Wexcombe College. He courted Nell Harcourt with romantic gestures, sending her flowers and sonnets, which led the college community to anticipate their engagement. However, Nell eventually realized she did not truly love him, leading to the end of their relationship.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P39](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0039), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019), [v3 c40 P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_
